text:
pd-bot: [PagerDuty] ALERT fired -> service=cc-service severity=high. Trigger: spike in 5xx on /v1/generate. Incident: INC-2109. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2109

oncall-bot: Routed to service `cc-service` (rotation: cc-engineering). Escalation policy applied.

samir: who is on rotation for cc-engineering right now? @melissa can you ack?

melissa: on my way. grabbing phone. acking now.

pd-bot: ACK by melissa (melissa) at 2109876550 :white_check_mark:

jae: are pages supposed to go to cc-service? that seems odd for /v1/generate errors — should route to inference-core-prod.

priya: i was just in infra-alerts terraform, did we change the default PD service? i pushed a change to alert-manager earlier today.

samir: checking recent commits... PR #4522 merged into prod ~15m ago. it touches `alert-manager/alerts.yaml`.

samir: snippet from prod alert rule (from git history):
```yaml
- alert: High5xx
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="frontend",status=~"5.."}[1m])) > 50
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "5xx spike"
    pagerduty_service: "cc-service" # <- should be "inference-core-prod"
```

ops-sre: yep that looks like the culprit — pagerduty_service got set to cc-service in prod by mistake. small rotation got huge fanout.

melissa: ok i'm going to silence cc-service for 30m to stop the noise while we fix routing: `oncall-bot silence cc-service 30m`

oncall-bot: silence created for `cc-service` (30 minutes) by melissa.

melissa: also going to update the PD binding to point to inference-core-prod so new alerts land there. doing `pd-cli` now.

melissa: `pd service update --id svc_cc123 --name inference-core-prod --integration-key key_xxx` (running)

pd-bot: Service update OK. Default routing for alerts now set to `inference-core-prod`.

jae: backlog: 12 pages in the last 6 minutes, 2 escalated to leads. some customers saw 500s — triage shows transient upstream overload.

samir: thanks. temporary mitigation = silence + rebind PD service. next: revert the terraform change and push a fix PR to ensure default is correct. priya can you revert?

priya: on it — creating PR to revert the accidental change and adding a test to validate `pagerduty_service` doesn't point to cc-service in prod. PR #4528 opened.

ops-sre: action items:
- priya: revert PR + test (#4528)
- melissa: runbook verification + confirm silence cleared after fix
- jae: customer comms + list impacted customers
- samir: postmortem ticket + incident severity assessment

melissa: i've sent a brief to support and postmortem kickoff. sending customer-facing note draft to #support for review.

jae: draft sent to support, ETA 20m for initial customer update.

pd-bot: Incident INC-2109 status -> mitigated (routing fixed). No new pages in last 4m.

samir: summary for timeline: 1) PR merged with wrong PD binding, 2) alert triggered, 3) pages routed to cc-service, 4) silence + rebind performed, 5) revert PR + tests opened.

priya: completed revert PR link: https://git.example/pull/4528

melissa: verified runbook steps and re-enabled alerts for inference-core-prod with `oncall-bot unsilence cc-service` (we left cc-service silenced and moved routing — unsilencing cc-service now to restore non-prod flows)

oncall-bot: unsilenced `cc-service`.

ops-sre: writing post-incident checklist and playbook updates. will add automated CI check to ensure `pagerduty_service` matches allowed list.

jae: customer comms out. no further escalations.

pd-bot: Incident INC-2109 -> RESOLVED at 2109876620. Closure reason: misrouted pager binding fixed; follow-ups opened (#4528, INC-FIX-678).

melissa: thanks all. assigning owners in the follow-up ticket.

samir: closing thread, will start postmortem doc. :memo:
